releases.displayName: Hot Fix for choose & draw cards

items.text: Hello Ironhoofs, We tracked down more cases of choosing card (like Enlighten, Combat Roll etc.) sometimes failed to draw the selected cards. They are now fixed! Special thanks to steam users 'Daybreak', 'Hammer_time' and 'Azure' for reporting more details that helped us greatly. Cheers!
Critical bug fix

Fixed cards dynamically added during combat (usually by enemies) causing issues for drawing card effect (e.g. Enlighten, Hero's dance, Combat Roll, Twin suit and etc.). Thanks everyone from the community to share screenshots and logs that helped us debug!
Others
Choose card effect no longer shuffle discard pile to draw pile if draw pile is empty. This was added mistakenly yesterday as a wrong bug fix.
Fix Unstoppable achievement description inaccurate.
Hello Ironhoofs,

We're so thrilled that you all loved the game and really thankful for the positive reviews and great feedbacks! We've been working hard on a bigger patch that will add some new content like relics/enchantments, tons of QoLs, making crappy builds more viable and new ways to challenge the hardcore players. The patch will probably be ready in a few weeks. At the mean time we're closely monitoring the community and will hotfix whenever needed.
Bug Fixes & Adjustments
Fixed Druid's Outgrow ability not working.
Slightly reduced difficulty in fishing and mining.

Discard pile will be shuffled back to draw pile if player triggers any kind of choose & draw a card effect when the draw pile is empty. This fixes issues of occasionally there's no card to choose from when using abilities like Enlighten, Combat Roll etc.
Librael will leave after giving tutorial on Enchantment, avoiding her blocking some card candidates.
After beating Act 3, the end screen will use color to indicate whether a requirement has been fulfilled for entering Act 4.
Fixed fishing tutorial not reset after using 'Reset Tutorial' from Settings.
Hello Ironhoofs,

items.text: Hello Ironhoofs,

Today’s update introduces improvements to map progression and makes your choices more meaningful. Rest nodes previously carried too much weight: healing, learning abilities, fishing, gambling etc, leading to unclear tradeoffs. To fix this, we’ve added a new Training Node and revamped how Rest Nodes work.
(New) Training Node
Training Nodes let you learn a new ability and participate in an activity like Fishing or Blackjack. You’ll encounter two of these nodes on each map.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45782250/e013f22b6a9f955633bc46b352ae520df6c213f9.png"]
Rest Node Revamp
Rest Nodes now offer a choice: heal for free, or take a gift from Librael.
A guaranteed Rest Node has also been added before every Boss fight.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45782250/5db07ba5b1fcae018c9a5f612c26d8a0297c803f.png"]
\[Agile Move] and \[Combat Roll] now let you pick a card from the draw pile instead of drawing randomly.
\[Pile of Wood] now grants +15 Max HP when you choose to rest.
\ Enchantment returns with a new mechanic: convert 2 cards in hand into Jacks.
\[War Cry] now grants extra Power if the drawn card is red.
Direwolf no longer attempts to summon pups when its squad is already full.
Fixed background issues at certain resolutions.
Fixed relics not being awarded in specific events when the consumable inventory is full.
Improved Fishing mechanics.
Slightly reduced beginner-zone enemy gold rewards.
Updated Main Menu buttons.
Cursor will change to sword icon when hovers over enemies.
Hello Ironhoofs!

We’ve received a large amount of feedback since the demo launch, and it’s been extremely helpful in reshaping the core mechanics of Heroes of Magic & Cards. This update focuses on addressing two major themes: stronger synergy between decks and abilities, and increasing turn-to-turn pacing and excitement. Version 0.2.1 introduces a broad set of improvements to card flow, abilities, enchantments, and overall combat dynamics.
All hand cards are now discarded at end of turn.
Draw +1 card per turn for every learned ability (increasing total card flow as you progress).
These changes significantly increase card flow and add more surprise and decision-making each turn.
Abilities now have a Uses counter, visible in the ability shortcut bar. The goal is to make each turn to have more interesting choices and flexibility.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45782250/3aa1f2b1827a8bae601ce382f0d3c4e6f8ae68f2.gif"]
Added new abilities to help players build powerful hands that are otherwise unlikely to occur by chance (e.g., 3-of-a-kind, straights) and interact more directly with poker enchantments.
\[Battle Preparation] - Add 2 Ace with \[Omni Suit] to the draw pile.
\[Combat Roll] - Exchange a card for a new one.
\[Warrior Dance] - Create a card of the same rank in hand.
\ - Rank up a card in hand.
\[War Cry] and \[Force Charging] now include card-draw components.
New Enchantment
\ – The enchanted card remains in your hand (it is not discarded at end of turn).
Reworked Enchantments
\ – Now adds 2 copies of the card to your draw pile.
\[Hot Sausage] – Bonus hand score now scales with your current Rage.
\ – Removed the drawback of taking 25% extra damage while this card is in hand.
Removed Enchantments
Removed due to providing generic combat effects rather than interesting poker-hand interactions:
You can now open the full map at any time by clicking the map icon in the top-right corner of the screen.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45782250/26aeb84bfc0daf1bb822aec471bafdeeb5a00e84.png"]
Elite and Boss enemies now drop 2 enchantment packs.
Fixed hover issues on enemy intents and statuses.
Improved visuals for the Event encounter scene.
Great Web Weaver, Thugs, The Golden Burrower, and The Stoneborn now apply their enchantments to cards in the draw pile instead of the hand.
Adjusted activation patterns for several Warrior abilities.
Boars and Gnolls now apply a negative status for their stealing effect instead of performing a direct action.
The Golden Burrower during burrow stage is now damageable (with 75% damage reduction) instead of being untargetable.
Damage dealt while under Rage Infusion no longer generates Rage.
The guaranteed rest node before the Boss has been moved earlier so players can learn a new ability sooner.
Random rest nodes are removed.
Fixed several description typos.
Fixed multiple localization issues.
Updated many relic effects to match the new card-draw rules.
\[Ginseng Tea] now adds +1 Use to all abilities this turn.
Maps will now generate with slightly more paths.
Temporarily removed relics that alter ability activation requirements.
